decisions.reason: As a niche extension of the core spraying business that remained listed through 2024, it likely has enough strategic fit and low enough carrying cost to keep the option open.
Its dedicated product page and evidence of field testing reduce uncertainty, so the expected value of continuing this close-to-core product remains favorable.
Because it is a multi-model line built on proven air-motor technology and closely leverages existing capabilities, it is a low-risk option worth retaining.
Although somewhat more adjacent than the pump products, its dedicated page and relevance to monitored system solutions support keeping it on the market while demand develops.
This is the newest launch and still more uncertain, but since it is close to the established offer the firm would likely keep it for another year to learn more before abandoning it.
